jobs.title: Smart Mobile Proctoring
jobs.description: Smart Mobile Proctoring: Prevent Mobile Cheating During Tests | LuGo-Test Products Products Lugo Force - Powered by Lugo Lite Features Candidate Chatbot New Smart Mobile Proctoring AI Questions Builder Pricing Clients Tests Library Support Products Products Lugo Force - Powered by Lugo Lite Features Candidate Chatbot New Smart Mobile Proctoring AI Questions Builder Pricing Clients Tests Library Support Login Proctoring Feature Smart Mobile Proctoring Turn the candidate's phone into a second camera and get a live view of their surroundings during the test - beyond the screen. See what's happening around the candidate in real time and gain a clearer, more complete view of the testing environment. Start Today Works with any smartphone camera - nothing to install Scan to start monitoring Opens the camera on the candidate's phone The Problem The blind spot in technical assessments Limited visibility beyond the screen Traditional webcam monitoring only captures what's directly in front of the camera. Undetectable use of external devices Phones and tablets positioned outside the camera frame stay completely out of view. A gap between performance and real skills Without full visibility, results don't always reflect what a candidate can actually do. Our Solution Smart Mobile Proctoring closes that gap Candidates link their phone as a second camera in three simple steps - no app to download, monitoring starts automatically. 01 Scan the QR code The candidate scans a code on their computer screen to connect their phone to the test. 02 Position the camera A quick permission prompt and on-screen guide help frame the desk, keyboard, and screen. 03 Monitoring begins Once confirmed, both devices stay connected - monitoring runs in real time until the test ends. Automatic Risk Scoring Every snapshot reviewed for you Face and environment snapshots are scored automatically, so a risk summary is waiting the moment the test ends. Proctoring Snapshots Candidate session · both cameras Duration 45 min Snapshot every 3 min Screens 1 Risk summary High High risk: 3 Low risk: 2 Low mobile coverage Total snapshots: 24 01:00 min 03:00 min 06:00 min 09:00 min Candidate flagged as high risk 3 snapshots showed signs of possible cheating and require manual review Key Benefits What this enables 1 Higher confidence in results Make hiring decisions based on verified, fully-monitored candidate performance. 2 Reduced cheating risk Full-room visibility closes the gap that phone and tablet cheating relies on. 3 Scales with your hiring volume Automatic monitoring and scoring handle thousands of tests without extra reviewer time. 4 A seamless candidate experience Setup takes under a minute and never disrupts the flow of the test. See what's happening beyond the screen Turn on Smart Mobile Proctoring for any test, at no extra cost, and get full visibility from the very next session.
